verdict.rationale: Granola documents a pre-meeting brief: it preps overnight, and when you open the note as you join you see a short brief with open threads, relevant context and agenda points. This covers the core 'walk in prepped with open threads' need. However, the brief is only 2-3 bullets, and its context is described as coming from the web or your calendar. Nothing explicitly shows past meetings with the same attendees being surfaced. Missing for 10: explicit surfacing of prior meetings with the same participants, depth beyond a 2-3 bullet brief, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call

citations.quote: Granola preps you for your meetings overnight. Open your note as you join and you'll see a short brief with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points
Open your note, and you'll see a short brief – usually 2-3 bullet points – with open threads, relevant context from the web or your calendar
See upcoming meetings, create notes from events, and get meeting context.
